title: 第29集 第15章 滨海的驱魔界第29集 第14章 劫起驱魔人
lines: “你们几个小兔崽子，赶紧去练拳。”方大龙对那群姨娘身边的孩童们吼道。
“是，爹。”立即有六个孩童连高声应道，还是忍不住好奇看了看家族的长兄，长兄听说可是朝廷大官，还是驱魔人。可老爹的威信太大，这六个孩童都一如往常跑去练拳了。
“岐儿，我带你去你的房间。”方大龙对长子却是和颜说道。
孟川倒是了解方大龙的发家史。
方大龙能从普通乡下人爬起来，靠的就是能打。这个世界也是有拳法的，也有所谓的拳法大宗师……可拳法大宗师，也就千斤之力，仗着拳法精妙能以一敌百罢了。随着火器兴起，拳法地位越加没落。毕竟十几杆火枪一同开枪，拳法大宗师也得狼狈而逃，毕竟他们也是血肉之躯，稍稍跑慢了身上就得多几个孔。
“这个院子是你的。”方大龙带孟川来到一小院，“屋子的布置和老家一样。”
说着推门而入。
孟川一眼看出，屋子经常打扫，很干净，摆放也和记忆中差不多。还放着一张相片，那是一对夫妇抱着儿女的照片。
夫妇，男人是年轻时的方大龙，女人却是一位温柔的妇人。
“你的东西，都从老家一同搬过来了，一件没丢。”方大龙说着，走过去轻轻擦拭了照片，在他年轻时，照相是很奢侈的，他当初依旧带着妻子儿女兴高采烈去城里照了相。
十六岁那年，他方大龙就成亲了，妻子十七，大一岁。
他白手起家，在那混乱世道硬是创出了一番大家业，和叛军势力有交往，和当地朝廷官员也关系极好，威震周围百里，曾有当地官员要对他下手，之后那官员就被叛军刺杀了。
当地一群凶人都信服他，追随他，甚至他也带了不少同乡来到滨海。
”我最后悔的，就是同意你去京城，去驱魔院。”方大龙放下相片，坐在床上叹息道，这一刻这个老父亲苍老不少。
“是我当初想要当驱魔人，不怪你。”孟川说道。
年少时的方岐，听说过驱魔人驱魔的场景，便心生向往。
“我不同意，你一个小崽子怎么去得了京城？”方大龙瞥了儿子一眼，叹息道，“还是我当初野心太大，想着火器这玩意太厉害，我们方家靠拳法传家不够靠谱，得学更厉害的手艺。所以我才让你去京城驱魔院……在这乱世，就是金银粮食都没用，只有靠人，靠厉害的本事才能立足。驱魔人的手段，不管谁家都得敬畏三分。”
孟川看得出，方大龙的确是枭雄人物。
在家乡，带领一群凶人威震百里。来到如今最繁华的滨海城，能买下如此大宅子，护院便有十几位，可见依旧颇为地位。
“我愧对你娘，我在你娘坟前发过誓，一定照顾好你们兄妹俩，我食言了。”方大龙声音有些无力。
在外界他依旧凶悍，可终究过四十岁了，他能感觉到身体大不如以前。
“不过你回来就好。”方大龙看着儿子，“回来就找几房女人，生几个娃娃，好好过日子。”
“小妹呢？”孟川却转移话题。
“你妹妹她又在外野着呢，太过宠她，越来越管不了了。”方大龙摇头道，虽然后来娶了些姨太太，也有了其他孩子，但也只有方岐、方倩这一对兄妹他最为宠爱，也最是管不住。
孟川点头。
在记忆中，妹妹方倩，是方岐同父同母的亲妹妹。
继承了这一肉身，便是欠了方岐因果，孟川对方岐最关心的人自然也很重视。
仅仅半个时辰后，妹妹方倩便赶回来了。
“哥，哥。”波浪卷发的方倩飞奔着，沿着走廊跑到了孟川的小院。
孟川听到声音，从屋内走了出来，一眼便看到一名活力四射的年轻美貌女子，妹妹方倩容貌有照片上母亲的几分模样，但更为年轻，眼神都很亮。毕竟是从小练拳长大，精气神很足。
方倩也看着眼前的布衣青年，袖子空荡荡，显然断臂了，气息内敛沉稳，完全不像二十岁出头，更像是四五十岁经历过风霜的老一辈。
方倩看着哥哥模样，哥哥离家已是少年，完全能看出当初的模样，只是更成熟了。
只是这气质……
方倩知道，断臂对哥哥的打击一定很大。
“哥。”方倩跑去，紧紧拥抱住兄长，泪水都浸湿了孟川的衣裳。
“三姐，如今这位大少爷回来了，老爷不会让大少爷掌家吧？”
“老爷对那对兄妹可宠的很。”
五个妇人聚在一起，吃着点心讨论着。
“放心，如果方岐这位大少爷不是残疾，又有驱魔本事，十有八九是会掌家。但他是个残疾，我们方家也是大户人家，让残疾掌家会成为滨海城的笑话。我听说残疾之后，驱魔本事都废了，用火器都不行，如今这世道，根本没资格掌家。”三姨娘自信道。
如今三姨娘在方家后院中，隐隐是地位最高的，毕竟她本是跟随老爷的数十位凶人之一，一手枪法也是精准的很，手下也有不少人命，嫁给老爷后，其他姨娘自然畏惧她一头，她的见识也要广不少。
她的推测很有道理，原本只是普通驱魔人的方岐，数名同伴合力才能对付一头诡魔。断臂后实力怕是只剩下一成……连和同伴联手去对诡魔的资格都没有。驱魔本事说废了，也相差不远。
content_en:
"You little bastards, hurry up and practice boxing." Fang Dalong yelled at the children around the aunts.
"Yes, Dad." Six children immediately responded loudly. They couldn't help but look curiously at the eldest brother of the family. I heard that the eldest brother was a high-ranking official in the court and an exorcist. But Dad's prestige was too great, so the six children all went to practice boxing as usual.
"Qier, I'll take you to your room." Fang Dalong said to his eldest son He Yan.
Meng Chuan knew Fang Dalong's family history.
Fang Dalong's ability to rise from an ordinary country boy depends on his ability to fight. There are also boxing techniques in this world, and there are also so-called boxing masters... But the boxing masters only have the strength of a thousand catties, and can defeat one against a hundred by relying on their exquisite boxing skills. With the rise of firearms, the status of boxing has declined. After all, more than a dozen muskets were fired at the same time, and the boxing masters had to flee in panic. After all, they were also made of flesh and blood, and if they ran a little slower, they would have a few more holes in their bodies.
"This courtyard is yours." Fang Dalong took Meng Chuan to a small courtyard. "The layout of the house is the same as in my hometown."
He said and pushed open the door.
Meng Chuan could tell at a glance that the house was cleaned frequently, very clean, and the layout was similar to what he remembered. There was also a photo of a couple holding their child.
As a couple, the man is Fang Dalong when he was young, but the woman is a gentle woman.
"All your things were moved from your hometown together, and not a single thing was lost." Fang Dalong said, walking over and gently wiping the photos. When he was young, taking pictures was very luxurious, and he still took his wife and children to the city happily to take pictures.
When he was sixteen, Fang Dalong got married. His wife was seventeen, one year older.
He started from scratch and managed to create a big business in that chaotic world. He had contacts with the rebel forces and had a very good relationship with the local court officials. He was powerful and powerful for hundreds of miles around. There was a local official who wanted to attack him, but the official was later assassinated by the rebels.
A group of local fierce people believed in him and followed him, and he even brought many fellow villagers to Binhai.
"What I regret most is that I agreed to let you go to the capital and go to the Exorcist Academy." Fang Dalong put down the photo, sat on the bed and sighed. At this moment, this old father had aged a lot.
"I wanted to be an exorcist in the first place. I don't blame you." Meng Chuan said.
When Fang Qi was young, he heard about the scene of exorcists exorcising demons, and he yearned for it.
"I don't agree. How can you, a brat, go to the capital?" Fang Dalong glanced at his son and sighed, "I was too ambitious at the time, thinking that firearms were too powerful. Our Fang family's legacy of boxing is not reliable enough. We have to Learn a more powerful skill. That’s why I asked you to go to the Capital Exorcist Academy... In this troubled world, even gold, silver and food are useless. You can only rely on people and powerful skills. No matter who you are, you have to respect them."
Meng Chuan could see that Fang Dalong was indeed a heroic figure.
In his hometown, he led a group of fierce men and was powerful for hundreds of miles. Coming to Binhai City, the most prosperous city nowadays, to be able to buy such a big house, there are more than a dozen nursing staff, which shows that it is still quite prestigious.
"I'm ashamed of your mother. I swore in front of your mother's grave that I would take good care of you two brothers and sisters. I broke my promise." Fang Dalong's voice was a little weak.
In the outside world, he is still fierce, but after all, he is over forty years old, and he can feel that his body is not as good as before.
"But it's good if you come back." Fang Dalong looked at his son, "When you come back, find a few women, have a few babies, and live a good life."
"Where's the little sister?" Meng Chuan changed the subject.
"Your sister is out in the field again. I spoil her too much and I can't control her anymore." Fang Dalong shook his head and said. Although he later married several concubines and had other children, only Fang Qi and Fang Qian, the brother and sister, he doted on the most and couldn't control them the most.
Meng Chuan nodded.
In my memory, my younger sister Fang Qian is Fang Qi’s half-sister.
By inheriting this body, he owed Fang Qi karma. Meng Chuan naturally attached great importance to the people Fang Qi cared about most.
…
Only half an hour later, my sister Fang Qian rushed back.
"Brother, brother." Fang Qian, with wavy hair, ran quickly along the corridor to Meng Chuan's courtyard.
Meng Chuan heard the sound and walked out of the house. He saw an energetic young and beautiful woman at a glance. His sister Fang Qian looked like his mother in the photo, but she was younger and her eyes were bright. After all, he grew up practicing boxing and is very energetic.
Fang Qian also looked at the young man in civilian clothes in front of her. His sleeves were empty and his arm was obviously broken. His breath was restrained and calm. He didn't look like someone in his early twenties at all, but more like an older generation who had experienced hardships in their forties or fifties.
Fang Qian looked at her brother's appearance. He was already a teenager when he left home. He could still see his original appearance, but he was more mature.
It’s just this temperament…
Fang Qian knew that a broken arm would be a huge blow to her brother.
"Brother." Fang Qian ran over and hugged her brother tightly, her tears soaking Meng Chuan's clothes.
****
"Third sister, now that the eldest young master is back, I won't let him take charge of the family, right?"
"My master is very fond of those brothers and sisters."
Five women gathered together, eating snacks and discussing.
"Don't worry, if the eldest young master Fang Qi was not disabled and had the ability to exorcise demons, he would most likely be the head of the family. But he is disabled, and our Fang family is also a big family. Having a disabled head will become a joke in Binhai City. I heard that after being disabled, the ability to exorcise demons is useless, and you can't even use firearms. In today's world, you are not qualified to run a family." The third aunt said confidently.
Nowadays, the third aunt has the highest status in the Fang family's backyard. After all, she is one of the dozens of murderers who follow the master. Her shooting skills are also very accurate, and she has killed many people under her command. After marrying the master, the other aunts are naturally afraid of her, and her knowledge is much wider.
Her speculation is very reasonable. She was just an ordinary exorcist.
